_meta.purpose: Page Template Schema: describe a page type independently from theme, device, and content.
_meta.scope: Template owns page structure (which regions exist, their order), supported devices/themes, layout pattern choices, and content requirements. It does NOT own visual style (theme) or spatial allocation internals (layout pattern/policy).
_meta.key_principle: Same Template can switch Theme (visual swap, zero structure change). Same Template can have PC/Mobile different Layout Variants. Same Layout Pattern is reusable across Templates.
_meta.usage: Planner: Requirement -> pick template by page_type -> select device -> select theme -> template.variants[device] gives layout pattern -> policy refines to directive -> components fill regions.

regions.role: preview | metadata | inspector | content | list | form | actions | related
regions.content_source: component ids or content model fields expected here

pc.condition: policy condition (aspect-ratio / metadata size / title length)
pc.layout_pattern: split | master-detail | grid | stack | preview-inspector | sidebar-content
